name: Jilin Quanyangquan Co., Ltd. Class A
summary: Jilin Quanyangquan Co., Ltd. operates across several distinct business areas, focusing on the production and distribution of forestry products, various door types, and bottled mineral water. Furthermore, the company supplies seedlings and undertakes projects related to garden engineering and landscaping construction. This enterprise was founded on September 29, 1998, and its main corporate office is situated in Changchun, China.
